raw_segments.text: Do you know anything of the construction of the human frame?
If not, it is proper that you should be told what every child ought to know, that when
its admirable economy has been disturbed by intemperance or indolence—I speak not of
violent disorders, but of chronic diseases—it must be brought into a healthy state again
And if the functions of life have not been materially injured—regimen—another word
for temperance, air, exercise, and a few medicines prescribed by persons who have studied
the human body are the only human means, yet discovered of recovering that inestimable
blessing health that will bear investigation.
